trials.name: A Phase 2 Two-Part Study of Oral PS1 in Healthy Volunteers and Adults With Newly Diagnosed Type 1 Diabetes
trials.officialTitle: A Phase 2, Two-Part Study of Oral PS1 Comprising a Pharmacokinetic, Safety, and Tolerability Bridging Study in Healthy Volunteers and an Exploratory Efficacy, Safety, Tolerability, and Pharmacokinetic Study in Adults With Newly Diagnosed Type 1 Diabetes
trials.assignment: registry drug/condition context; ownership and active pipeline not inferred

design.interventionModelDescription:
Part A is an open-label, parallel-group sub-study to characterize the PK characteristics, and determine the safety, and tolerability of PS1 via oral administration in healthy volunteers.

Part B is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled sub-study to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and PK characteristics of PS1 via oral administration in combination with standard of care (SOC) for adults diagnosed with T1D within ≤12 months.

maskingInfo.maskingDescription: Part A is an open-label study. Part B is a double-blinded study.

eligibility.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Part A

  * Male or female non-Asian participants aged 18 to 60 years, inclusive at screening.
  * BMI between 18 and 32 kg/m2.
  * Overtly healthy participant, who is considered to be generally healthy based on medical history, vital signs, laboratory tests, 12 lead ECG, and physical examination, as judged by the investigator.
  * With HbA1c value of \<6.5% and fasting plasma glucose \<110 mg/dL at screening.
  * With estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) \>80 mL/min/1.73 m² (according to a chronic kidney disease epidemiology collaboration equation \[CKD-EPI\] 2021 creatinine equation for adults).
* Part B

  * Male or female participants aged 18 to 50 years, inclusive, at the time of signing the informed consent form (ICF).
  * Participants have received a diagnosis of T1D within ≤12 months according to American Diabetes Association (ADA) criteria at the time of screening.
  * Documented treatment with stable exogenous insulin therapy for a minimum of 14 consecutive days prior to randomization.
  * Evidence of residual endogenous β-cell function, defined as a peak stimulated C-peptide of ≥0.2 pmol/mL from a standardized 2-hour MMTT at screening.
  * Participants have a positive result on testing for at least 1 of the T1D-related autoantibodies before randomization (results from a local laboratory are acceptable).
  * Participants are able to comply with the SOC of T1D management and all protocol procedures for the duration of the study.
* Part A and Part B

  * Negative test for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), hepatitis B core antibody (HBcAb), anti-hepatitis C virus (HCV) antibody, and human immunodeficiency virus at screening. Participants with positive anti-HCV may be enrolled only if they have a negative HCV RNA result during the screening period.
  * Female participants of childbearing potential must have a negative result on a highly sensitive serum (β human chorionic gonadotropin) test at screening.
  * Participants agree not to receive other forms of experimental treatment during the study, particularly agents that may be immune modulatory in nature and/or stimulate pancreatic β cell regeneration or insulin secretion.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Part A

  * History of type I or type II diabetes mellitus.
  * Participants who are receiving systemic treatment with any prescription or over-the-counter medication that, in the investigator's judgment, may interfere with safety or PK assessments within 7 days before dosing.
  * Participants who have received a strong CYP enzyme inhibitor or inducer within 14 days before dosing.
  * Received any vaccination within 2 weeks or live or attenuated vaccines within 4 weeks before screening.
  * Known hypersensitivity to any of the components of PS1 tablet.
  * History of pancreatitis.
  * History of major clinically significant hematologic, renal, respiratory, gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, hepatic, psychiatric, neurological, musculoskeletal, immune, or allergic disease (including drug allergies, but excluding untreated, asymptomatic, seasonal allergies at the time of dosing) within 3 months of screening that may significantly alter the biomarker panel, require receiving any systemic medications, or interfere with the interpretation of data, as judged by the investigator.
  * Serum amylase \>1.5 × ULN or lipase \>1.5 × ULN, at screening.
  * Participants with alanine aminotransferase (ALT) or aspartate aminotransferase (AST) \>2 × ULN, or total bilirubin \>1.5 × ULN (except in participants with Gilbert's syndrome), at screening.
  * Clinically significant ECG abnormality at screening.
  * Took glucose-lowering medications within the last 2 weeks prior to screening
  * Received any investigational therapy from another clinical study within the last 12 weeks prior to screening.
  * Received any systemic steroids (inhaled and intranasal steroids are permitted) or other immunosuppressive medications within 4 weeks prior to dosing.
  * Underwent any major surgery within 12 weeks or any non-major surgeries within 4 weeks prior to dosing
* Part B

  * Have known allergies, severe reactions, intolerance, hypersensitivity, or anaphylaxis to PS1 or any of its components or its excipients
  * Have been an active participant in a therapeutic drug, invasive medical device, or vaccine clinical study within 30 days or 5 half lives (whichever is longer) before the first dose of the study drug or have received an investigational treatment with the potential for T1D disease modification
  * Have an HbA1c ≥10%
  * Have experienced 1 or more episodes of DKA within 30 days prior to randomization or have had 1 or more emergency room visits or hospitalizations due to poor glucose control (severe hyperglycemia or hypoglycemic episodes) within 1 month prior to randomization.
  * Have a history of acute or chronic pancreatitis
  * Have a serum triglyceride level \>500 mg/dL (5.6 mmol/L) at screening
  * Have a serum lipase or amylase level \>1.5 × ULN at screening
  * Have eating disorders or any gastrointestinal problems that might, in the opinion of the investigator, impact/confound the results of the study or interfere with the participant's ability to comply with the study procedures.
  * Have a known malignancy, with the exception of successfully treated non-metastatic basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma.
  * Have a diagnosis of sickle cell disease or other hemoglobinopathies that may interfere with interpretation of HbA1c or glycemic endpoints.
  * Have a diagnosis of significant liver disease at screening, or ALT and/or AST \>2 × or total bilirubin \>1.5 × the age- and sex-specific ULN (Note: Participants with Gilbert's syndrome may be allowed to enroll upon approval by the medical monitor).
  * Have any of the following hematologic parameters, confirmed by repeat tests, within 10 days before randomization or the first dose of the study drug:

    * Lymphocyte count: \<500/μL
    * Neutrophil count: \<1500/μL
    * Platelet count: \<100,000/μL
    * Hemoglobin: \<10 g/dL
  * Have impaired renal function, defined by an eGFR (according to CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation) of \<60 mL/min/1.73 m2.
  * Have received current or prior (within 30 days before screening) treatment that is known to cause a significant ongoing change in the course of T1D or immunologic status, including high dose inhaled, extensive topical, or systemic glucocorticoids. (Note: Short courses, ie, approximately 2 weeks or less, of corticosteroids for transient conditions are allowed).
  * Have current or prior (within 30 days before screening) use of drugs other than insulin to treat hyperglycemia (eg, metformin, sulfonylureas, glinides, thiazolidinediones, exenatide, liraglutide, dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors, or amylin).

arms.label: Part A - SAD - 25mg
arms.description: An eligible healthy subject will receive a single dose of 25 mg of PS1 on Day 1 and be followed for 7 days.

arms.label: Part A - SAD - 50mg
arms.description: An eligible healthy subject will receive a single dose of 50 mg of PS1 on Day 1 and be followed for 7 days.

arms.label: Part B - 25mg
arms.description: An eligible subject will receive one 25 mg PS1 and one PS1 matching (placebo) tablet once daily for 12 weeks (approximately 3 months) in a blind manner, and will be followed up to 16 weeks (approximately 4 months) from the start of the treatment.

arms.label: Part B - 50mg
arms.description: An eligible subject will receive two 25 mg PS1 tablets once daily for 12 weeks (approximately 3 months) in a blind manner, and will be followed up to 16 weeks (approximately 4 months) from the start of the treatment.

arms.label: Part B - placebo
arms.description: An eligible subject will receive two PS1-matching (placebo) tablets once daily for 12 weeks (approximately 3 months) in a blind manner, and will be followed up to 16 weeks (approximately 4 months) from the start of the treatment.

design.interventionModelDescription: An "open-labeled" study design will be applied for the SAD portion for T2DM patients with two SAD dose cohorts-25 mg (Cohort A) and 50 mg (Cohort B).

eligibility.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

A subject is eligible for the study if all of the following apply:

1. Both genders aged 18 to 80 years, inclusive at screening
2. Body mass index (BMI) between 18.5 and 40.0 kg/m2
3. Negative test for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), Anti-HCV antibody, and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) at screening. Subjects with positive anti-HCV may be enrolled only if they have a negative HCV RNA result during the screening period.
4. Is willing to follow the trial life style instruction and protocol procedure
5. Able to understand and sign the informed consent form

   Inclusion criteria applied for healthy subjects (Cohorts 1\~4)
6. Overtly healthy subject, who is considered to be generally healthy based on medical history, vital signs, laboratory tests, 12-lead EKG, and physical examination, as judged by the investigator
7. With HbA1c value of \< 6.5% and fasting plasma glucose \< 110 mg/dL at Screening
8. With estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) \> 80 ml/min/1.73m2

   Inclusion criteria applied for T2DM patients (Cohorts A, B, 7, and 8)
9. Diagnosis of T2DM
10. T2DM treated with diet and exercise alone currently, for at least 2 weeks prior to Screening
11. With HbA1c level between 5.7% to 9.0% or fasting plasma glucose level between 100 mg/dL to 250 mg/dL at Screening
12. With estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) \> 60 ml/min /1.73m2
13. Patients taking medications for T2DM comorbidities, i.e., hypertriglyceridemia, hyperlipidemia, and hypertension, should be on a stable dose of their medication for at least 3 months prior to Screening. Any other chronic medications should be on a stable dose for at least 4 weeks prior to Screening.

Exclusion Criteria:

Any subject meeting any of the following exclusion criteria will be excluded from study participation.

1. History of Type I diabetes mellitus
2. Under the systemic treatment of any prescription medication or over-the-counter (OTC) medication that may interfere with the safety or PK assessment judged by the investigator within 7 days before Screening
3. Received strong CYP enzyme inhibitor or inducer within 14 days before Screening
4. Received any vaccination within 14 days before Screening
5. Has required insulin therapy within the past 12 weeks
6. Known hypersensitivity to any of the components of PS1 tablet
7. History of major clinically significant hematological, renal, respiratory, gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, hepatic, psychiatric, neurological, musculoskeletal, immune, or allergic disease (including drug allergies, but excluding untreated, asymptomatic, seasonal allergies at the time of dosing) within 3 months of Screening that may significantly alter the biomarker panel, require receiving any systemic medications, or interfere with the interpretation of data, as judged by the investigator-other than T2DM and its comorbidities (i.e., hypertriglyceridemia, hyperlipidemia, and hypertension)

12. Regular smoker Regular smoker is defined as who smokes every day (≥ 1 cigarette/day in average in the past 8 weeks of Screening)
13. Consumed greater than 3 units of alcoholic beverages per day in average for the past 4 weeks before Screening One unit is equivalent to one can of beer (\<10% alcohol; about 330 mL), one glass of wine (10\~20% alcohol; about 150 mL), or one shot of distilled spirits (\>20% alcohol; about 45 mL)
14. Received any investigational therapy from another clinical study or underwent any major surgeries within the last 12 weeks prior to Screening

18. Other conditions not suitable for participating in this study as judged by the investigator

    * Is lactating; or
    * Has a positive pregnancy test result at Screening; or
    * Refuses abstinence or to adopt at least two forms of highly effective contraception from signing informed consent to the end of the study.

    Exclusion criteria applied for healthy subjects (Cohorts 1\~4):

population.eligibilityRaw:
Inclusion Criteria:

A subject is eligible for the study if all of the following apply:

1. Both genders aged 18 to 80 years, inclusive at screening
2. Body mass index (BMI) between 18.5 and 40.0 kg/m2
3. Negative test for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), Anti-HCV antibody, and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) at screening. Subjects with positive anti-HCV may be enrolled only if they have a negative HCV RNA result during the screening period.
4. Is willing to follow the trial life style instruction and protocol procedure
5. Able to understand and sign the informed consent form

   Inclusion criteria applied for healthy subjects (Cohorts 1\~4)
6. Overtly healthy subject, who is considered to be generally healthy based on medical history, vital signs, laboratory tests, 12-lead EKG, and physical examination, as judged by the investigator
7. With HbA1c value of \< 6.5% and fasting plasma glucose \< 110 mg/dL at Screening
8. With estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) \> 80 ml/min/1.73m2

   Inclusion criteria applied for T2DM patients (Cohorts A, B, 7, and 8)
9. Diagnosis of T2DM
10. T2DM treated with diet and exercise alone currently, for at least 2 weeks prior to Screening
11. With HbA1c level between 5.7% to 9.0% or fasting plasma glucose level between 100 mg/dL to 250 mg/dL at Screening
12. With estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) \> 60 ml/min /1.73m2
13. Patients taking medications for T2DM comorbidities, i.e., hypertriglyceridemia, hyperlipidemia, and hypertension, should be on a stable dose of their medication for at least 3 months prior to Screening. Any other chronic medications should be on a stable dose for at least 4 weeks prior to Screening.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) during the DLT observation period and the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of PS1
primaryOutcomes.description:
Dose escalation will be terminated based on the following criteria:

\- Among the six subjects who received PS1 in a cohort, more than one subject experienced DLT(s). MTD will basically be declared as the highest dose level at which ≤1/6 of PS1-treated subjects in a cohort experienced DLT(s).

DLT is defined as

1. any adverse event (AE) ≥ Grade 3 (CTCAE v5.0)\* or
2. Grade 2 AE that does not resolve to grade 1 or less within 3 days\* \* Note: For Cohorts 7 and 8, AEs requiring specific definitions will be referenced under the heading 'For MAD cohorts (Cohorts 7 and 8)' below, while the remaining AEs will be followed the standard procedures outlined herein.

that occurs in the DLT observation period and is causally related (possibly, probably, or definitely related) to the test article judged by the investigator.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: DLT observation period: from Day 1 to EOS - For SAD and FE cohorts in healthy subjects: from Day 1 to Day 8±1 - For MAD cohorts in T2DM patients: from Day 1 to Day 35±1
